title: Best guide so far i've met
text: Lens was an excellent guide, very informative, smiling and accommodating. I can feel she loves and enjoy her work. Shell have a Five stars from us. Regards, Ramon (Concierges retired at Radissonblu Scandinavia Oslo)

title: Value for money
text: Really enjoyed the tour, Moha is a very great guide!
author: dievas1

title: Gloria was fantastic
text: Gloria was great. She shared with us many details of the Sagrada Família that one would not have picked up on if there was no guide. She would point to different statues and pose for us to recognize the statue. She made an effort to learn everyone name. She was passionate.
author: Marco_M

title: Worthwhile trip to Sagrada Família
text: Guide was prompt knowledgeable, informative,  English was excellent.  Great tour.
author: rondio2024

title: Would do it again
text: Super nice, approachable, knowledgeable. Def would take the tour again and recommend people Maria. Very easy place to find the meeting point. No time wasted got to the good stuff.

title: A knowledgeable tour guide will really enrich the experience of your visit
text: The tour was very well done, with just the right amount of detail.  Our guide Daria was both enthusiastic and knowledgeable. It’s obviously a beautiful structure but we wouldn’t have appreciated it as much without a knowledgeable guide.
author: mike-duesseldorf

title: Fascinating tour
text: It was a great tour, Jose the guide was incredible and explained everything about Basilica. The time was perfect and we had some fantastic pictures of the colorful light. I strongly recommend this tour.
author: aris1895

title: Amazing Tour
text: Very informative tour with Albert from Experience First . Money well spent and what we saw was beautiful and amazing . Memories to last a lifetime .
